statement: The lengths of the sides of a triangle are \(6\), \(8\), and \(10\) units. Prove that there is exactly one straight line which simultaneously bisects the area and perimeter of the triangle.
Prove or disprove that there exists an integer which is doubled when its initial (leading) digit is transferred to the end.

Let \(P_1\) and \(P_2\) be regular polygons of \(1985\) sides and perimeters \(x\) and \(y\) respectively. Each side of \(P_1\) is tangent to a given circle of circumference \(c\), and this circle passes through each vertex of \(P_2\). Prove that \(x + y \geq 2c\). (You may assume that \(\tan\theta \geq \theta\) for \(0 \leq \theta < \dfrac{\pi}{2}\).)
Prove that \(2^{n-1}\) divides \(n!\) if and only if \(n = 2^{k-1}\) for some positive integer \(k\).

Let \(1 < x_1 < 2\) and, for \(n = 1, 2, \ldots\), define \(x_{n+1} = 1 + x_n - \tfrac{1}{2}x_n^2\). Prove that for \(n \geq 3\),
\[|x_n - \sqrt{2}| < 2^{-n}.\]
